editorial: Imagine a world where faith is your only weapon, and your goal is to topple a giant. David (2025), a biblical epic with a slow-burn tone, breaks routine by letting silence speak louder than spice. Joaquin Phoenix carries every frame with an almost empty dialogue, leaning into the raw terror of a lone shepherd. The film builds its tension through lush, almost cavernous shots that invite you to feel the weight of every stone. You will be drawn in if you crave story-driven historical dramas that explore the limits of conviction.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of story-driven historical dramas who appreciate deep character study.
watchReasons: intimate depiction of faith under threat
